title: Executive orders

rows.text: Executive orders
18 draft packages. Images have no embedded text; wording listed as an overlay is rendered separately.
ORDER-DEREGULATE-A · Peace, Now With More War
The government promotes “Department of War” branding. The spokesperson calls it peace through strength. Your van would settle for peace through a working alternator.
Game effect: While active, apply the displayed bonus to breakdown risk before the game’s risk limits. This does not itself trigger or repair a breakdown.
When it expires: The reorganization event ends. The van has retained its original, less threatening name.
Scene: Official renaming ceremony on a roadside screen; the van’s hood sits open in the foreground.

Editable overlays: “Department of War” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it; “Peace through strength” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: Department of War naming
ORDER-DEREGULATE-B · Two Names, One Purchase Order
Trump’s War Department branding brings another reorganization. Officials order new signs before checking the equipment. Your van has nominated its rattle for a leadership position.
Game effect: While active, apply the displayed bonus to breakdown risk before the game’s risk limits. This does not itself trigger or repair a breakdown.
When it expires: The event expires. The rattle is demoted to a maintenance issue.
Scene: A pristine blank sign is delivered beside neglected machinery while a traveler listens to the van.
Editable overlays: “Reorganization” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: Department of War naming
ORDER-DEREGULATE-C · The Branding Campaign
Officials explain that calling defense “war” will project strength. The crew tries calling the van “a tank.” The suspension files an immediate objection.
Game effect: While active, apply the displayed bonus to breakdown risk before the game’s risk limits. This does not itself trigger or repair a breakdown.
When it expires: The branding event ends. The van accepts a return to civilian duties.
Scene: Travelers glance at their battered van beside a grand military-name unveiling shown on an unlettered display.
Editable overlays: “Department of War” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: Department of War naming
ORDER-GAG-A · A Very Dangerous Index
Book-panic bulletin: officials copy Trump’s ban on classroom “indoctrination.” The approved reading list arrives pre-approved, with instructions on how freely to discuss it.
Game effect: While active, the displayed sanity cost applies only below the morale protection threshold shown by the game.
When it expires: The panic recedes. A librarian quietly moves the books back where people can accidentally learn things.
Scene: Librarian stands beside a locked book cart and a large blank approved-reading sheet.
Editable overlays: “Approved free thinking” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: Anti-indoctrination and patriotic education
ORDER-GAG-B · The classical refund

Trump’s architecture order prefers classical designs for covered federal buildings. A rest-stop owner copies it with cardboard columns around the snack machine. One blocks the coin return. It now serves the grandeur of Western civilization. It no longer serves coins.
Game effect: While active, the displayed sanity cost applies only below the morale protection threshold shown by the game.
When it expires: The bulletin ends. The owner moves a column and gets his test coin back. The machine manages this without consulting an architect.

Scene: The owner points at cardboard columns around the snack machine while currently present travelers look on; no purchase or attempt to retrieve change is shown. A grand cardboard column stands directly in front of the machine’s small coin-return opening.
Editable overlays: “CLASSICAL GRANDEUR” — Blank homemade pediment
Source: Executive Order 14344: Making Federal Architecture Beautiful Again (2025-08-28)
ORDER-GAG-C · The Pronoun Emergency
Officials announce another emergency about gender in schools. The roof still leaks. Nobody has established the puddle’s biological sex.
Game effect: While active, the displayed sanity cost applies only below the morale protection threshold shown by the game.
When it expires: The bulletin expires. The puddle has acquired a second bucket and no political affiliation.
Scene: A classroom hallway has two buckets beneath roof leaks while a huge blank policy binder sits dry on a shelf.
Editable overlays: “Emergency guidance” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: Anti-indoctrination and patriotic education
ORDER-MILITARIZE-A · Freedom of Movement, Subject to Movement
Checkpoint bulletin: officials invoke Trump’s border-security rhetoric to add another road inspection. The officer asks why free citizens are always trying to go somewhere.
Game effect: While active, lose the displayed sanity amount each day. Travel distance uses the displayed reduced multiplier before daily limits.
When it expires: The extra inspections end. Your destination is once again a place rather than an explanation.
Scene: Van waits behind a new portable barrier while an officer consults a blank checklist.
Editable overlays: “Security inspection” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: 2025 entry restrictions and extreme vetting
ORDER-MILITARIZE-B · America, Please Hold
Trump-style extreme vetting demands proof you belong here. The van’s registration, your accent and your patience are called forward separately.
Game effect: While active, lose the displayed sanity amount each day. Travel distance uses the displayed reduced multiplier before daily limits.
When it expires: The restriction expires. Your patience is still waiting to have its documents returned.
Scene: Traveler holds blank documents at a checkpoint; the van waits behind them with luggage visible.
Editable overlays: “Travel restriction” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: 2025 entry restrictions and extreme vetting
ORDER-MILITARIZE-C · The Domestic Border
Officials bring “extreme vetting” to another stretch of road. Your crew explains you’re already in America. The guard says that’s what everyone says.
Game effect: While active, lose the displayed sanity amount each day. Travel distance uses the displayed reduced multiplier before daily limits.
When it expires: The order ends. The road stops interviewing its users.
Scene: An ordinary domestic road is split by a portable inspection booth; a traveler points toward the same landscape on both sides.
Editable overlays: “Extreme vetting” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: 2025 entry restrictions and extreme vetting
ORDER-SHUTDOWN-A · Essential, Unpaid
Shutdown bulletin: Congress has run out of agreement. Federal workers are asked to keep being essential on an optional-salary basis.
Game effect: While active, lose the displayed supply and morale amounts at the start of each game day, including rest days.
When it expires: The shutdown ends. Paychecks may resume pretending this was a scheduling problem.
Scene: Closed public-service windows below a warmly lit political fundraiser; an ordinary worker waits with a lunch bag.
Editable overlays: “Government shutdown” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: Unlimited independent political money
ORDER-SHUTDOWN-B · Open for Contributions
The government shuts down. Services close; political fundraising emails continue arriving. Apparently the donation button is essential infrastructure.
Game effect: While active, lose the displayed supply and morale amounts at the start of each game day, including rest days.
When it expires: Services reopen. Nobody has needed to reboot the donation button.
Scene: Dark public-service monitors beside one brightly glowing, blank campaign-donation screen.
Editable overlays: “Government closed” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it; “Donate” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: Unlimited independent political money
ORDER-SHUTDOWN-C · Hostage Negotiations
Congress fails to keep the government open. Your next meal has been invited to participate in the negotiations. It wasn’t given a chair.
Game effect: While active, lose the displayed supply and morale amounts at the start of each game day, including rest days.
When it expires: The shutdown ends. The food budget is released without a thank-you note.
Scene: An ordinary empty dinner plate sits below oversized negotiation chairs in an illustrative cutaway; no claim of an actual meeting.
Editable overlays: “Government shutdown” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: Food assistance cuts
ORDER-TARIFFS-A · Foreign Aid, Domestic Wallet
Trump’s tariff message says foreign countries will pay. Your grocery bill has volunteered to be a foreign country.
Game effect: While active, lose the displayed supplies each day unless your carried legal fund provides protection.
When it expires: The tariff event ends. Your wallet would like its citizenship restored.
Scene: Plain grocery bag sits between an empty wallet and a blank customs invoice.
Editable overlays: “Foreign countries pay” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: Trump tariffs passed to Americans
ORDER-TARIFFS-B · The Importer Is You
Another tariff bulletin promises to punish overseas producers. At the shop, the punishment is itemized beneath your bread.
Game effect: While active, lose the displayed supplies each day unless your carried legal fund provides protection.
When it expires: The event expires. The bread is released into your custody.
Scene: Cashier shows a blank receipt long enough to curl around one modest loaf.
Editable overlays: “Tariff surcharge” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: Trump tariffs passed to Americans
ORDER-TARIFFS-C · Protected From Purchasing
Officials announce protection for American consumers through higher import taxes. The food remains safely on the shelf, beyond the reach of American consumers.
Game effect: While active, lose the displayed supplies each day unless your carried legal fund provides protection.
When it expires: The tariff event passes. You and the shelf resume diplomatic relations.
Scene: Traveler stretches toward groceries while a tall blank price card visually stands between them.
Editable overlays: “Protected market” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: Trump tariffs passed to Americans
ORDER-TAXCUTS-A · Education Has Left the Building
The education department is eliminated. Officials promise to preserve learning. The exit sign has been assigned the remaining teaching hours.
Game effect: While active, lose the displayed morale amount at the start of each game day.
When it expires: The order ends. The exit sign returns to its specialist subject.
Scene: Empty education office with a lone illuminated, unlettered exit-sign panel above a tiny lectern.
Editable overlays: “Department closed” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: Education Department dismantling direction
ORDER-TAXCUTS-B · School of Hard Cuts
The education department closes. Students are directed to the school of hard knocks. It is already charging for the door.
Game effect: While active, lose the displayed morale amount at the start of each game day.
When it expires: The order expires. The school of hard knocks keeps your application fee.
Scene: An office door is closed while a student-facing service counter has a blank fee jar and no staff.
Editable overlays: “School of hard knocks” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: Education Department dismantling direction
ORDER-TAXCUTS-C · Discover It Yourself
Officials eliminate the education department. The announcement calls it empowerment. The teacher begins explaining long division with the remaining half of a pencil.
Game effect: While active, lose the displayed morale amount at the start of each game day.
When it expires: The order ends. The pencil requests a colleague.
Scene: Teacher holds half a pencil before a large empty board; a blank closure notice is pinned beside the door.
Editable overlays: “Empowerment” — Separate editable overlay on the indicated blank prop or beside it
Source: Education Department dismantling direction
